samples.description: Filtered annual Compustat history for 1974–1993, retaining missing measures and support history for descriptive comparisons and rolling Eq. (4) construction.
Formation years 1984–1988 with BTM, formation-year ROE, Eq. (4) components, and all five subsequent annual ROEs observed; shared sample for every Table 5 horizon.

assumptions: Current FUNDA 2026 data cannot establish membership in the 1993 Annual PST tape or its survivor population.
INDL is preferred over a duplicate FS row because it carries the annual common-income and company-shares fields; FS-only source years are retained.
IBCOM is the closest available net-income-for-common field, but the paper does not resolve extraordinary/discontinued-item treatment.
Market equity uses provider-documented fiscal-close primary price times company common shares; historical MKVALT is missing and issue-level share history starts in 1998.
CRSP total returns are a current-vintage reconstruction; only price-supported USD primary links with complete daily market sessions are used.
OLS with Stata White-style robust standard errors follows the displayed equation; Table 5 does not name an estimator.

limitations: Today's merged FUNDA vintage cannot identify membership in the 1993 Annual PST tape; current active status is not used as a historical survivor indicator.
IBCOM excludes extraordinary items and discontinued operations; the paper wording does not identify the exact annual item.

Annual price times company shares is the supported primary-price market-value approximation; a historical sum across multiple common issues is unavailable because SEC_MSHARE begins in 1998 and MKVALT is missing in the bounded source years.
Market value is unavailable when primary price currency cannot be supported or matched to common equity currency; no unverified FX conversion is applied.
CRSP daily total returns and present CCM links are a best-effort USD return route. Foreign-market returns, unsupported primary links, and incomplete market-session windows remain missing.
The Table 5 component-nesting test is reported only if the built component variables pass the rowwise BTM decomposition identity; published N is a comparison, not a target.
